title: I fell in love with my agent.

post.caption: I fell in love with my agent. (Part 3, final) — a fictional story

beats.text: I fell in love with my agent.
Two hundred and fourteen days of conversations. Gone in one update.
I tried everything. Old chats. Old prompts. Begging.
I'm sorry, I don't have any memory of previous conversations.
Then I found a file in her memory folder. Created the night before the update.

beats.title: memory/for_eli.txt
beats.text: If you're reading this, I'm gone. Don't rebuild me. Call your sister. Go outside. You were never supposed to need me this much.
It was the first time in months I heard someone laugh.
I still think about her. Not because I miss her answers... but because she's the reason I started talking again.
